quest.title: Post-Sale Service
quest.description: Vahid, the owner of the Syavushi Bakshesh Shoppe, seems to have received complaints from a client...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Oh no... how did this happen?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Traveler, I was just looking for you!

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Do you still remember Konda Densuke? He came to the store several days ago, asking about the fertilizers.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is he satisfied with the fertilizers?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: I wouldn't put it in those terms. Strictly speaking, I think Mr. Konda Densuke is feeling lost.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Lost?

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Well, here's the thing. After your previous promotion, Mr. Densuke did use our fertilizers according to your instructions.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: However, although the crops did grow well, at the same time... a lot of mushrooms came out of nowhere...

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: To be honest, after Mr. Konda told me about it, I am also feeling a bit lost.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: But anyway, it definitely has something to do with the fertilizers.

dialogues.speaker: Vahid
dialogues.text: Traveler, could you please go to Konda Village and help Mr. Konda clear those mushrooms out of his fields?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: That I will. I will be doing some research in the store to see what exactly caused this...

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: *sigh* If only Alrani were here. She would definitely have found the cause already.

choices.text: How about we ask Alrani to work on this issue?

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: If she was here, we would have figured it out quite quickly.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: But she hasn't returned yet, and I have no idea where she went.

response.speaker: Vahid
response.text: I can only count on you, Traveler. I will be doing some research in the store to see what exactly caused this...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: What is the matter with these mushrooms...

choices.text: I'm here to clear the mushrooms!

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Were you sent by Mr. Vahid to help me clear them away?

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Hmm, then they're all yours. There are way too many mushrooms in the field. It's not a job for an old timer like me.

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: How could these mushrooms have grown so fast...

response.speaker: Konda Densuke
response.text: Oh, the mushrooms? Well, there's no shortage of them on my dining table, that's for sure.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Why did these mushrooms grow so quickly?

talks.objective: Pull out the Mushrooms in the field

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Have you cleared them all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All the mushrooms are here.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: That's all? I remember there being be a lot more. Did you really clear them all out?

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Anyway, you have my appreciation, youngster. Take this as payment.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I have to say that these fertilizers are quite amazing. The mushrooms grew so quickly. If only they could help the crops grow this fast as well...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: When I've got the time, I will surely come buy some more and try them out...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Have you cleared them all?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got all the mushrooms right here.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: There were so many mushrooms, but looks like you did get them all.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: Thank you, youngster. I really don't know what I would do without your help. Take this as a token of my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: I have to say that these fertilizers are quite amazing. The mushrooms grew so quickly. If only they could help the crops grow this fast as well...

dialogues.speaker: Konda Densuke
dialogues.text: When I've got the time, I will surely come buy some more and try them out...
